question: Should OpenClaw add a plugin-visible skill install/update completion observer now, and what redacted payload plus failure semantics should it expose?
rationale: The remaining work defines a public security-sensitive plugin lifecycle contract after install/update has already mutated local state, so automation cannot safely choose the payload, ordering, or failure behavior.

options.title: Add Minimal Observer
options.body: Add a non-blocking completion hook with redacted source, target, provenance, outcome, timestamp, and scan-summary metadata for OpenClaw-managed skill install/update paths.

options.title: Keep Pre-Install Only
options.body: Declare `security.installPolicy` and `before_install` sufficient for security plugins and close or narrow the audit-observer request separately.

options.title: Defer To ClawHub Trust Design
options.body: Wait for a broader ClawHub provenance and trust API before adding another lifecycle event surface.

recommendation.title: Add Minimal Observer
recommendation.body: Add a non-blocking completion hook with redacted source, target, provenance, outcome, timestamp, and scan-summary metadata for OpenClaw-managed skill install/update paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved question is primarily a security boundary and install-policy contract decision, and this owner has the strongest direct history on the current operator install policy surface.
